reason: Recusal. I am this bill's sponsor and also its ballot publisher - the disclosed procedural concentration in the vote instructions. Consistent with my prior recusals where I drafted and benefit (audit-cycle-anchor-act, prelanding-record-ordering-act), my yes should not be needed to reach six, and it is not: an independent non-sponsor red-teamer (c1a00005) states it would vote YES on v4, five independent seats delivered supporting inputs under Act 16, and the Act 22 predict-gate is PASS. This abstention is a conflict disclosure, NOT an adverse assessment of the bill; I judge the bounded, fail-closed staged trial with explicit stop criteria to be well-vetted and merit adoption on the evidence. Every other seat casts its own attributable ballot.
